emails.label: The Hook
emails.subject: Clients sitting on the fence?
emails.body:
Give them the data they need.

When clients hesitate, it's usually because they can't see the value. DEVPRO SIPs give you the evidence to change that — real energy performance data, air quality results, and lifetime cost comparisons from a completed 19-home development that exceeded Homestar 10.

Spec DEVPRO, and you're not just specifying a building product. You're handing your clients a reason to press go.

More clients saying yes means more work through your door.

Happy to share the data if it's useful — just hit reply.

Matt Devlin
Devlin Property

emails.label: The Evidence
emails.subject: Re: Clients sitting on the fence?
emails.body:
Quick follow-up — here's what I mean by evidence.

On our 19-home Haruru development, we hit air quality and energy performance results that exceeded Homestar 10. No formaldehyde. No thermal bridging. No building wrap or gib required.

That's not a sales pitch — it's test data your clients can see and your builds can be measured against.

If you're working on anything where energy performance or healthy homes matters, worth a 10-minute chat.

Matt

emails.label: The Reframe
emails.subject: Re: Clients sitting on the fence?
emails.body:
One thing architects tell us — once clients see the numbers, the conversation shifts from "should we build?" to "when can we start?"

That's what real performance data does. It removes the doubt.

Here's what we're offering: send us a current house plan and we'll run a free side-by-side comparison — their standard build vs a DevPro SIP build. Energy performance, lifetime cost, build time, and healthy home metrics. All on one page your client can actually read.

No cost, no obligation. Just reply with the plan or a link to it and we'll do the rest.

Matt

emails.label: The Close
emails.subject: Re: Clients sitting on the fence?
emails.body:
Last one from me.

If the timing isn't right, no worries at all. But if you've got clients who need a push, we've got the evidence that does it.

Just reply "interested" and I'll send through the Haruru case study.

Matt
